sql.user.searchUsers:
select u.id, u.first_name, u.last_name, u.first_name || ' ' || u.last_name as full_name, u.email, u.phone_number, u.company_id
from flow.user u where u.company_id = :companyId and u.first_name || ' ' || u.last_name ILIKE '%' || :query || '%' order by u.last_name, u.first_name, u.start_date desc limit :limit offset :offset ;
sql.user.searchUserCount: select count(*) from flow.user u where u.company_id = :companyId and u.first_name || ' ' || u.last_name ILIKE '%' || :query || '%'
sql.user.exportUsers: select u.id, u.first_name, u.last_name, u.first_name || ' ' || u.last_name as full_name, u.email, u.phone_number, u.company_id from flow.user u where u.company_id = :companyId and u.first_name || ' ' || u.last_name ILIKE '%' || :query || '%' order by u.last_name, u.first_name, u.start_date desc
sql.user.updateUser: update flow."user" set first_name = :firstName, last_name = :lastName, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now(), company_id = :companyId where id = :id
sql.user.insertUser: insert into flow.user(first_name, last_name, created_by_id, company_id) values(:firstName, :lastName, :createdById, :companyId)
sql.user.getOne: select u.* from flow."user" u where u.id = :id
sql.user.findByUsernameIgnoreCase: select u.id, u.first_name, u.last_name, u.email, u.username, u.password, u.company_id, null as "timezone", u.first_name || ' ' || u.last_name as full_name, u.user_status_type_id, c.aws_bucket, c.company_name, c.abbreviation as company_abbreviation, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(permissions))) FROM ( select per.id, per.permission_name as "permissionName", per.permission_code as "permissionCode" from flow.permission per left join flow.role_permission rp on per.id = rp.permission_id left join flow.role role on rp.role_id = role.id left join flow.user_role ur on ur.role_id = role.id where ur.user_id = u.id AND role.archived is not true and per.archived is not true except select per.id, per.permission_name, per.permission_code from flow.permission per left join flow.user_permission udp on udp.permission_id = per.id where udp.user_id = u.id and udp.deny is true and per.archived is not true ) permissions), '[]') as permissions from flow.user u inner join flow.company c on c.id = u.company_id where lower(username) = lower(:username)
sql.user.findByUserUuid: select id, first_name, last_name, first_name || ' ' || last_name as full_name, user_status_type_id from flow.user where uuid = :uuid
sql.user.findUserById: select u.id, u.first_name, u.last_name, u.company_id, c.aws_bucket, u.first_name || ' ' || u.last_name as full_name, u.user_status_type_id from flow.user u inner join flow.company c on c.id = u.company_id where u.id = :id
